title: Best Practices for Mental Health Providers Supporting 9-1-1 Professionals
usable_for: anchors 9-1-1 telecommunicator occupational stress, wellbeing, and support language for voice-only death witnessing
do_not_use_for: publishing a public record without consented witness material and role-specific review
treating role vocabulary as clinical, legal, emergency, funeral, investigative, ritual, therapeutic, benefits, or operational advice
collapsing professional, family, official, and first-person accounts into one evidentiary type
extracting identifiable stories, child material, worker confessions, calls, images, or restricted cultural material
claiming exact prognosis, universal meaning, spiritual proof, blame, eligibility, or correct next steps
extraction_rules: extract role vocabulary, access limits, source limits, and review gates
mark whether the source is official, professional, family-facing, peer-reviewed, public-health, jurisdiction-specific, or association-based
separate observed role from authority to interpret the whole death
route care, law, safety, benefits, emergency, investigative, and ritual questions to appropriate local professionals or community authorities
